luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local drive = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "diskdrive")
check(drive ~= nil, "wrap diskdrive")
check(drive.hasDisk() and drive.getDisk().getCount() == 1, "hasDisk")
local key = drive.getDiskKey()
check(key ~= nil, "disk key")

check(drive.setDiskName("WT Disk") and drive.getDiskName() == "WT Disk", "disk name")
local data = json.decode(drive.getDiskData())
check(data.name == "WT Disk" and data.luamadeDiskId ~= nil, "disk data")
check(drive.setDiskData("{}"), "setDiskData")
check(json.decode(drive.getDiskData()).luamadeDiskId ~= nil and drive.getDiskKey() == key, "disk id kept")
check(drive.getDiskName() == nil, "name cleared")

fs.write("/home/wt_prog.lua", "print('hi from disk')")
check(drive.saveProgram("/home/wt_prog.lua", "wtprog"), "saveProgram")
local found = false
for _, n in ipairs(drive.listPrograms()) do if n == "wtprog" then found = true end end
check(found, "listPrograms")
check(drive.installProgram("wtprog", "/home/installed.lua"), "installProgram")
check(fs.read("/home/installed.lua") == "print('hi from disk')", "installed content")
check(not drive.installProgram("missing", "/home/x.lua"), "missing program refused")

check(drive.sellProgram("/home/wt_prog.lua", "wtpaid", 500), "sellProgram")
check(drive.getProgramPrice("wtpaid") == 500, "getProgramPrice")
check(drive.buyProgram("wtprog", "/home/bought.lua") == 0, "buy free program")
check(fs.read("/home/bought.lua") == "print('hi from disk')", "bought content")
check(not pcall(drive.buyProgram, "wtpaid", "/home/paid.lua"), "priced program needs vault")
check(drive.buyProgram("missing", "/home/x.lua") == nil, "buy missing is nil")

check(drive.write("/notes/a.txt", "on disk"), "disk write")
check(drive.read("/notes/a.txt") == "on disk", "disk read")
print("PASS disk_drive")
